---
title: "GitHub CLI"
---

Install GitHub CLI (`gh`) with the Git tools role. It provides GitHub functionality from the command line; ordinary source-control operations remain Git commands.

```sh
ansible-playbook -i inventory -K playbooks/lab-stack.yml --tags git
```

::: {.callout-manual}
**🔧 Manual setup and configuration**

Authenticate once for each user account:

```sh
gh auth login --web
```

Each user runs this interactive command and authenticates their own GitHub account in the browser. Ansible does not store credentials, tokens, usernames, or other account-specific data.
:::

::: {.callout-check}
**✅ Check**

```sh
gh --version
gh auth status
```
:::

## Common commands

View or clone repositories:

```sh
gh repo view
gh repo clone OWNER/REPOSITORY
```

Work with pull requests and issues:

```sh
gh pr list
gh pr view
gh pr create
gh issue list
```

Inspect GitHub Actions runs and releases:

```sh
gh run list
gh run view
gh release list
```

## Creating releases

Create and push the Git tag explicitly before creating the GitHub release:

```sh
git tag -a v0.1.0 -m "v0.1.0"
git push origin v0.1.0

gh release create v0.1.0 \
    --verify-tag \
    --title "v0.1.0" \
    --generate-notes
```

`--verify-tag` prevents accidentally creating a release for a tag that does not already exist remotely. `--generate-notes` lets GitHub generate the release notes automatically.

View the release or list available releases afterward:

```sh
gh release view v0.1.0
gh release list
```
